name: alibi
description: Documentation and deployment tooling for Alibi

scripts.docs:plan: APP_ENV=production bun --bun varlock run -- alchemy plan alchemy/alchemy.run.ts --stage prod --profile better-auth-rs
scripts.docs:deploy: APP_ENV=production bun --bun varlock run -- alchemy deploy alchemy/alchemy.run.ts --stage prod --profile better-auth-rs
scripts.docs:destroy: APP_ENV=production bun --bun varlock run -- alchemy destroy alchemy/alchemy.run.ts --stage prod --profile better-auth-rs
